title: Silk and Venom
description: Kettil Marsh pulled his whole crew out of the mine north of Millbrook after losing two men in the lower galleries. The owners are paying to get their ore moving before the crew take other work. Kettil wants to see the queen's body.

objectives.description: Reach the mine north of Millbrook
Kill the spiders in the galleries
Collect venom sacs for the alchemists
Tell Vorn the mine is clear

notes: Spider infestation dungeon near Millbrook. Boss fight against spider queen. Venom sacs are valuable alchemy materials. Rewards include special spider silk rope item useful for climbing/exploration. Threat: a mine idled after two miners died, its foreman (Kettil Marsh) and crew refusing to go back. Giver motive: the mine's owners are paying to get ore moving before the crew scatters for good. Consequence: the crew leaves for other work if the mine stays shut - stated in prose, not wired.
